headline: Unlocking Q2 Potential of AEP (AEP): Exploring Wall Street Estimates for Key Metrics
summary: Beyond analysts' top-and-bottom-line estimates for AEP (AEP), evaluate projections for some of its key metrics to gain a better insight into how the business might have performed for the quarter ended June 2026.
